title: The Difference Between Simple and Easy
short_teaser: Simple means having fewer parts or less complexity.
story: Simple means having fewer parts or less complexity. Easy means requiring little effort. A process may be simple but emotionally difficult, or complicated yet familiar enough to feel easy. Clear language prevents us from solving the wrong problem. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
